newsitem.title: USA: Franklin says ISS backs its Telephone/Data nominee.
newsitem.headline: Franklin says ISS backs its Telephone/Data nominee.

text.p: Franklin Mutual Advisers Inc said Wednesday Institutional Shareholder Services (ISS) has endorsed its nominee, Martin Solomon, to be elected to the Telephone and Data Systems Inc board.

Franklin Mutual said the Bethesda, Md.,-based ISS, a shareholder rights' advocate, had recommended that its clients vote to support Solomon's candidacy in opposition to Telephone and Data management's nominee.
Shareholders of the company are scheduled to vote for a director at Telephone and Data's annual meeting scheduled for May 16, Franklin Mutual said.
